target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard and tablet

cooperative_message_scheduling.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-task-message-scheduling-current-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-source-fast --probe-source tests/compat/TaskMessages.ZC --probe-source-call TaskMessageSchedulingChecks
verified: Five consecutive MessageScan, KeyScan, CharScan, and FlushMessages polls did not switch to a peer task.
An explicit Yield selected the next ready task.
A blocked MessageGet yielded to a ready peer, received its posted command, and resumed.

xcaliber.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-current-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
verified: X-Caliber reached gameplay after its startup popup.
Plain Left and Right each changed the ship scanout.
Space produced a visible projectile in the captured scanout.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal, which accepted and executed 40+7 as 47.
The complete compatibility process exited 0 and zstatus reported failed=0.

scope_note: These are automated QEMU/HVF results for this exact ISO. They do not establish live UTM-window or Pi hardware behavior. This run found no X-Caliber input/Escape failure in QEMU; it cannot resolve a previously reported live UTM-only failure. MessageScan remains a poll, and no Yield was added to MessageScan or X-Caliber. This does not mean the pinned upstream Sched.ZC is the scheduler currently running, nor does it establish SMP scheduling.
